review_questions: Does frozen Phase 4 remain the single timed scheduling authority and run exactly once?
Are policy decisions fully compiled and hash-bound before scheduling without predicted lanes or completion times?
Are token-level selected experts and top-k conserved without aggregate reconstruction or routing weights?
Does reserved nonexpert plus resident expert bytes remain within one authoritative capacity?
Do explicit eviction, load, barrier and assignment dependencies prevent pinned eviction and premature compute?
Are clean immutable eviction and no-writeback semantics explicit?
Are LRU/FIFO and OFF/HINT deterministic, causal and non-oracular?
Can postprocessing only validate and never repair the Phase 4 trace?
Does checkpointing bind a real live Phase 4 prefix and continue exactly after object or wire restore?
Do corruption, tamper, invalid routing, invalid enum and capacity violations fail closed?
Does the fresh R2 run bind the exact source root and pass Release plus native sanitizer regressions?
Is the stale R1 run excluded and explicitly non-promotable?
Does the candidate exact-set include all nested ledgers while excluding only its active ledger and current review results?
Are CPU_SYNTHETIC, RANGE_UNKNOWN and no-calibration/no-GPU claim boundaries explicit?
